<div class="card-body">
'''Stop Motion''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ストップ・モーション</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のマーカー位置にいる乗用生物を目標とする。運命数を引く。その位置が“夜間状態”なら運命数に2を加える。目標がトーントーンなら運命数の合計＞5でロストする。目標がそれ以外の乗用生物なら運命数の合計＞3でロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Stop-Motion-PSA-88099882.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「第1マーカーに着く前にトーントーンが凍えてしまいますよ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stop Motion.

'''Card text:'''
Target a creature vehicle at any marker location. Draw destiny. If that location is under nighttime conditions, add 2 to destiny. A tauntaun is lost if total destiny exceeds 5. Any other creature vehicle is lost if total destiny exceeds 3.

'''Lore:'''
The tauntaun will freeze before you reach the first marker.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses マーカー位置 for marker site and 乗用生物 for creature vehicle.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Stop Motion]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
